Query: what customers are buying less than last month
SQL: select T1.customers, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by customers) as T1 join (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by customers) as T2 on T1.customers = T2.customers where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: what customers are buying less than last month
SQL: select T1.customers, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by customers) as T1 join (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by customers) as T2 on T1.customers = T2.customers where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: what products are selling less than last month
SQL: select T1.product_service, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select product_service, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by product_service) as T1 join (select product_service, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by product_service) as T2 on T1.product_service = T2.product_service where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

Query: what customers are buying less than last month
SQL: select T1.customers, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by customers) as T1 join (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by customers) as T2 on T1.customers = T2.customers where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: what customers are buying less than last month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: what customers are buying less than last month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: what customers are buying less than last month
SQL: select T1.customers, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by customers) as T1 join (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by customers) as T2 on T1.customers = T2.customers where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

SQL: select T1.customers, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by customers) as T1 join (select customers, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table   as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by customers) as T2 on T1.customers = T2.customers where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: what products are selling less than last month
SQL: select T1.product_service, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from (select product_service, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by product_service) as T1 join (select product_service, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by product_service) as T2 on T1.product_service = T2.product_service where revenue_this_month < revenue_last_month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month

Query: give me the list of accounts where my revenue increased by more than [percentage]% in this month as compared to last month
SQL: select T1.account, revenue_this_month, revenue_last_month from(select account, sum(credit) as revenue_this_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date >= date(current_date,'start of month') group by account) as T1 join (select account, sum(credit) as revenue_last_month from master_txn_table  as T1 join chart_of_accounts as T2 on T1.account = T2.account_name where account_type in ('Income','Other Income') and transaction_date BETWEEN date(current_date,'start of month','-1 month') and  date(current_date,'start of month','-1 day') group by account) as T2 where (revenue_this_month - revenue_last_month) / revenue_last_month >= [percentage]/100
